# Game Idea: Starfall Dodger

**Concept**: An endless runner on an HTML5 canvas where the player pilots a small spaceship that constantly moves forward.

**Controls**: Tap or click to thrust upward against a constant downward pull (gravity). Releasing the input lets the ship drift down.

**Obstacles**: Randomly generated asteroids and laser beams appear from the right. The ship must dodge them.

**Lose Condition**: The game ends when the ship collides with any obstacle **or** falls off the bottom edge of the canvas.

**Scoring**: Distance traveled (or time survived) increases the score.

**Why Canvas?**: Simple 2‑D sprite rendering and collision detection fit perfectly on the canvas.

1: // Game: Starfall Dodger
2: // Implements an endless runner on a canvas with id="game"
3: // Ship drifts down due to gravity; click/tap applies upward thrust.
4: // Random obstacles appear from the right; collision ends the game.
5: 
6: (function () {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10: 
11:   // Set canvas size to its displayed dimensions
12:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
13:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
14: 
15:   // Audio setup
16:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
17:   const playSound = (freq, dur) => {
18:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
19:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
20:     osc.type = 'square';
21:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
22:     osc.connect(gain);
23:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
24:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
25:     osc.start();
26:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
27:   };
28:   const playThrust = () => playSound(300, 0.08);
29:   const playCrash = () => playSound(80, 0.3);
30: 
31:   const GRAVITY = 0.3;      // pixels per frame²
32:   const THRUST = -6;        // instantaneous upward velocity
33:   const SHIP_W = 30;
34:   const SHIP_H = 30;
35:   const OBSTACLE_W = 40;
36:   const OBSTACLE_H = 40;
37:   const OBSTACLE_SPEED = 3;
38:   const SPAWN_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms
39: 
40:   const ship = {
41:     x: canvas.width * 0.2,
42:     y: canvas.height / 2,
43:     vy: 0,
44:     w: SHIP_W,
45:     h: SHIP_H,
46:   };
47: 
48:   let obstacles = [];
49:   // Starfield background
50:   const STAR_COUNT = 100;
51:   const stars = [];
52:   for (let i = 0; i < STAR_COUNT; i++) {
53:     stars.push({
54:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
55:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
56:       size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
57:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
58:     });
59:   }
60:   let lastSpawn = 0;
61:   let startTime = null;
62:   let score = 0;
63:   let running = true;
64: 
65:   // Input handling – mouse or touch
66:   const applyThrust = () => { playThrust(); ship.vy = THRUST; };
67:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', applyThrust);
68:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); applyThrust(); });
69: 
70:   // Game loop
71:   function update(timestamp) {
72:     if (!running) return;
73:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
74:     const delta = timestamp - (lastSpawn || timestamp);
75: 
76:     // Update ship physics
77:     ship.vy += GRAVITY;
78:     ship.y += ship.vy;
79: 
80:     // Update starfield (move left)
81:     stars.forEach(star => {
82:       star.x -= star.speed;
83:       if (star.x < 0) {
84:         star.x = canvas.width;
85:         star.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
86:         star.size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
87:         star.speed = Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2;
88:       }
89:     });
90: 
91:     // Lose if ship hits bottom or top
92:     if (ship.y + ship.h > canvas.height || ship.y < 0) {
93:       endGame();
94:       return;
95:     }
96: 
97:     // Spawn obstacles
98:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > SPAWN_INTERVAL) {
99:       spawnObstacle();
100:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
101:     }
102: 
103:     // Update obstacles
104:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= OBSTACLE_SPEED);
105:     // Remove off‑screen obstacles
106:     obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
107: 
108:     // Collision detection (AABB)
109:     for (const o of obstacles) {
110:       if (rectIntersect(ship, o)) {
111:         endGame();
112:         return;
113:       }
114:     }
115: 
116:     // Update score (seconds survived)
117:     score = ((timestamp - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
118: 
119:     draw();
120:     requestAnimationFrame(update);
121:   }
122: 
123:   function spawnObstacle() {
124:     const y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - OBSTACLE_H);
125:     obstacles.push({ x: canvas.width, y, w: OBSTACLE_W, h: OBSTACLE_H });
126:   }
127: 
128:   function rectIntersect(a, b) {
129:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
130:   }
131: 
132: function draw() {
133:     // Background gradient (dark space to slightly lighter)
134:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
135:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#000020');
136:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000010');
137:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
138:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
139: 
140:     // Draw stars
141:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
142:     stars.forEach(star => {
143:       ctx.beginPath();
144:       ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
145:       ctx.fill();
146:     });
147: 
148:     // Draw ship – gradient triangle with optional thrust flame (already defined elsewhere)
149:     // Ship drawing code already updated in earlier edit; re‑use that logic here
150:     // (the ship gradient and flame are drawn separately in draw())
151:     // Draw ship body
152:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
153:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
154:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003300');
155:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
156:     ctx.beginPath();
157:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
158:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
159:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
160:     ctx.closePath();
161:     ctx.fill();
162:     // Thrust flame
163:     if (ship.vy <= THRUST) {
164:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
165:       ctx.beginPath();
166:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
167:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - 10, ship.y + ship.h / 2 - 5);
168:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - 10, ship.y + ship.h / 2 + 5);
169:       ctx.closePath();
170:       ctx.fill();
171:     }
172: 
173:     // Draw obstacles – gradient circles (asteroids)
174:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
175:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 4, o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2);
176:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
177:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
178:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
179:       ctx.beginPath();
180:       ctx.arc(o.x + o.w / 2, o.y + o.h / 2, o.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
181:       ctx.fill();
182:     });
183: 
184:     // Draw score
185:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
186:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
187:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
188:   }
189: 
190:     // Draw obstacles – red rectangles
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
192:     obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h));
193: 
194:     // Draw score
195:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
196:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
197:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, 10, 20);
198:   }
199: 
200:   function endGame() {
201:     // Play crash sound
202:     playCrash();
203:     running = false;
204:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
205:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
206:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
207:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
208:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
209:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 10);
210:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
211:   }
212: 
213:   requestAnimationFrame(update);
214: })();

(End of file - total 214 lines)
</content>
